title: Agentscrape preset
description: A preset in `config/presets/` or a project's `scrapers/` directory: the routing rule and extraction strategy for one kind of page.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion. The preset loader ignores it.

name.description: Registry identity for this preset. `--preset NAME` selects it, and the name must be unique among the official presets and among the local `scrapers/` presets.

summary.description: One-line description of what the preset extracts, shown by `list-presets`.

domain.description: Host this preset claims, or "*" to match any host. Declaring a domain claims the entire host: a URL on it that matches no preset fails rather than falling back to generic extraction.

mode.description: Extraction strategy. `content` runs a registered handler, `links` collects anchors under one selector, and `nav-links` walks a two-level navigation.

aliases.description: Further hosts claimed on the same terms as `domain`, such as twitter.com alongside x.com.

browser_profile.description: Browser profile the scrape runs under when the caller supplies none, for pages that need a signed-in session.

url_patterns.description: JavaScript regular expressions matched against the canonicalized URL. Each must carry a visible `^` start anchor and `$` end anchor, and no two presets may declare the same pattern.

handler.description: Registered content extractor to run, named `module.function`. The CLI never loads local executable code, so the handler must already be registered through the package API.

schema.description: Name of the ScrapeSchema class the handler returns. It must be registered together with `handler`.

selector.description: CSS selector for the anchors to collect.

toggle_selector.description: CSS selector for expander controls to click before links are collected, such as collapsed navigation sections.

section_selector.description: CSS selector for the top-level section links to visit.

category_selector.description: CSS selector for the links to collect on each section page that was visited.
